backtest.question: NC agencies later won 157 federal programs. Four weeks before each closed, how many were already in that agency's top 10?

rows.label: Newest-posted alert
rows.note: Stands in for the usual new-postings email; not measured with coordinators.

backtest.fails: Where it fails: 96 of the 157 won programs were not in the top 10. Reading the top 50 reaches 98 of 157 (62%). Keyword matching misses grants worded differently from the plan, and only 4 of 12 agencies clear our 50% bar.
backtest.source: Award-history backtest, 12 agencies with 3 or more won programs, 4-week windows, Nov 2024 to Nov 2026. Exploratory.

intime.say: Checking every 2 weeks, 53 of the 157 still had 21 or more days left to apply. Checking every 6 weeks, only 34 did. That gap is why the tool shows the data date and is set up to refresh every day.

_note: Hand-authored from src/docs/fact_sheet.md (row numbers in each fact). Copied into payload.json by R/11_build_payload.R; the tool reads payload.evidence.
